note: METRIC-06: OBB AP correctness baselines. This is the ONLY self-implemented matcher+AP in the repo, which is exactly why it had no parity anchor and carried two silent correctness bugs (audit METRIC-01 FP-dropping, METRIC-02 envelope interleaving). Every vector here is hand-computable; the audit reproductions pin the exact failure modes. Recording follows the fail-fast convention: delete the file and the suite fails once, then re-records.

envelope_tp_then_fp.description: METRIC-02: one GT, TP(0.9) then FP(0.8) — the all-point envelope must integrate the higher precision over the full recall span. Pre-fix: 0.5 (interleaved envelope); correct: 1.0.

envelope_tp_then_two_fp.description: METRIC-02 variant: three predictions, one TP — AP is 1.0 at all-point (envelope lifts the trailing FPs' precision to 1.0 over their recall span, which is zero-width) and 1.0 at coco101.

two_gt_one_tp_one_fp.description: Two GT, TP(0.9) then FP(0.8): recall reaches 0.5 with precision 1.0; AP = 0.5.
two_gt_one_tp_one_fp.note: Two GT, TP(0.9) then FP(0.8): recall reaches 0.5 with precision 1.0; all-point = 0.5; coco101 = 51/101 (points at/above recall 0.5 take the envelope precision 1.0 for the first 51 grid steps — COCO's grid semantics differ from plain half-area).

fp_before_tp.description: FP(0.95) ranked ABOVE TP(0.9): precision 0.5 over the whole span — AP 0.5 under both interpolations (the METRIC-01 audit scenario's PR stream).
